content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 6.1 (p0037) is a high-severity NONCOMPETE deviation. It restricts the Company from participating in any Internet project involving Deerskin Products or open-ended "substantially similar" products and "companies similar to" two named retailers, with no internal-development or acquisition carve-outs, and — because the term auto-renews annually under Section 4.1 — no effective 12-month cap. HDI's exclusive right over our own "Deerskin" brand compounds the problem by blocking us from using or licensing our own brand.

**Cure (preferred, one surgical replace):** Section 6.1 now affirmatively confirms the Company may participate in any Internet project involving Deerskin Products or other products and may use and license the "Deerskin" brand without restriction. HDI's own exclusivity covenant (6.3), our retained closeout-site right (6.2), and the separate non-exclusive Marks licence to HDI are all preserved, and no cross-reference is left dangling.
